description: The only cases a sqlite_parity, memory or rql_phase1 run may skip. Each entry names the suite, the case (id and name), the gap it covers (kind: target_capability when the target lacks a capability the case requires, rql_rewrite when the RQL phase-1 rewrite cannot express the case), why, who closes it, and the last UTC day an official run accepts it (expiry). redline-testing compiles this file in: a gap that is not listed fails its case (target_unsupported), a reference shell that lacks a declared capability always fails its case (reference_capability_missing), a listed case that runs fails the run, and `run --official` refuses an expired entry. The RedlineDB evidence processor requires each suite's skipped case ids, recomputed from its raw records, to equal this list and the run to have recorded this file's sha256. The rql_phase1 entries were seeded from the official lane run of 2026-09-27; reason is the rewriter's refusal from that run.
